locale.description: Default locale (e.g. 'pt_BR.UTF-8'). Affects date/time, number, and text formatting.

default_lang.description: Default language code (e.g. 'pt', 'en') for dictionaries and translations.

default_currency.description: Default currency code (e.g. 'BRL', 'USD') for financial queries.

default_encoding.description: Default character encoding (e.g. 'UTF-8', 'ISO-8859-1') for file input.

default_width.description: Default terminal width (columns) used by formatting utilities.

max_items.description: Default maximum number of items for listing functions.

user_agent.description: Default User-Agent header for HTTP requests.

cache_dir.description: Directory used for caching network lookups.

feriados_custom.description: Custom regional holidays in 'dd/mm: descrição' format, one per list item.
